description: This PHP class 'UserDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'User' entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to manipulate user-related data such as setting employee associations, user roles, and checking admin privileges. It also manages a non-hashed password for the user.

classes.name: UserDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the User entity providing additional methods to manage user-related data and roles, including setting employee reference, user role, checking admin status, and handling non-hashed passwords.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a User object.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Protected method to access the encapsulated User object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the User based on employee number.

methods.name: setUserRoleById
methods.description: Assigns a UserRole to the User entity based on role ID.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the associated user has an 'Admin' role.

methods.name: getNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the non-hashed password stored in the decorator.

methods.name: setNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Sets the non-hashed password in the decorator.
